Remark
[conformal fields on the sphere]

Source: petersen:page-0344 ↗ def:pet-ch8-killing-field 1. ch8:8.4.8Let $x^i$ be standard Cartesian coordinates on $\mathbb {R}^{n+1}$ and $V=\mathrm{span}_{\mathbb {R}}\{ 1,x^1,\dots ,x^{n+1}\} $, restricted to $S^n$. Show that for $u,v\in V$ the fields $u abla v-v abla u$ are conformal (a field $X$ is conformal if $L_Xg=\lambda g$ for some function $\lambda $).
